paragraphs: The Plant Moisture Detection project utilizes the arduino_stm32core framework, leveraging the STM32 HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer) and CubeMX for configuration. The core builds on the HAL drivers to provide a robust foundation for embedded systems development.

The code in Plant_Moisture_Detection.ino is structured with clear functions such as display, setup, loop, and renderOLED. This modular approach enhances maintainability and scalability of the project.
Peripherals are configured to interface with the system core clock, APB1 and APB2 prescalers, ADC prescaler, and specific pins for sensor measurement, LED control, and serial communication.

Operational challenges include eliminating sensor measurement noise through moving average filtering and handling inverted active-low onboard indicator logic. Reliable threshold or hysteresis state evaluation is crucial to prevent spurious state switching in the system.
The project utilizes ST-Link V2 via SWD interface for programming, allowing for efficient debugging and testing of the embedded system.
